title: Appraisal Order Reconsideration of Value Terms by Report Type
content:
Reconsideration of value terms, by Appraisal Order report type:

| Report type | Reconsideration allowed | Requests accepted per order | Window (calendar days after delivery to the borrower) | Most alternative comparable sales per request | Fewest alternative comparables for a comparable-sales request | Appraiser response due (business days) | Charge to the borrower (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Desktop Appraisal (Form 1004 Desktop) | Yes | 1 | 14 | 5 | 1 | 5 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Exterior-Only Appraisal (Form 2055) | Yes | 1 | 14 | 5 | 1 | 5 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Condominium Appraisal (Form 1073) | Yes | 1 | 14 | 5 | 1 | 5 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004) | Yes | 1 | 14 | 5 | 1 | 5 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur FHA Single-Family Appraisal (Form 1004 FHA) | Yes | 1 | 14 | 5 | 1 | 5 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Small Residential Income Appraisal (Form 1025) | Yes | 1 | 14 | 5 | 1 | 5 | 0.00 |
| Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo) | Yes | 2 | 14 | 5 | 1 | 7 | 0.00 |

**Meaning of each term.**
- *Reconsideration allowed* — whether the borrower may request a reconsideration of value; it is allowed for every report type.
- *Requests accepted per order* — the number of reconsiderations of value accepted on one order: 1, except 2 for the Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo).
- *Window* — the calendar days after delivery of the report to the borrower within which a request is accepted: 14.
- *Comparable sales* — a request may carry at most 5 alternative comparable sales; a request that rests on comparable sales needs at least 1.
- *Response* — the business days within which the appraiser's response is due: 5, except 7 for the Larkspur Complex Property Appraisal (Form 1004 Jumbo).
- *Charge* — the charge to the borrower for a reconsideration of value: 0.00 dollars for every report type.
